description: Smooth travel exposure—rural roads with a roughness level less than 4.2 IRI is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Percentage of travel undertaken each year on state-controlled rural roads with a roughness level condition of less than 4. 2 IRI. Please note: This is an inactive dataset and is no longer maintained by the Department of Transport and Main Roads. The last update to this dataset was done on the 15/11/2018. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are road, road condition, roughness, rural, smooth travel exposure. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-02-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
